'''[[General/Legends|General]] Farr-Nees''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Umbaran/Legends|Umbaran]] who lived during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. He and his people sided with the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatists]] during the [[Battle of Umbara/Legends|Battle of Umbara]]. He commanded [[Bunker Usk]], one of three underground bunkers, during the battle, but was defeated by a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] nonetheless.
